name: dbt-agents-brand-monitor
description: Authenticated, read-only access to approved Brand Monitor dbt marts in BigQuery.

interface.longDescription: Explore only the approved Brand Monitor dbt marts in development and production. Search documented tables and columns, inspect schemas, preview bounded samples, estimate query cost, and run guarded read-only SQL. The app has no access to operational datasets or Keylo data.
capabilities: Discover the approved Brand Monitor dbt marts
Search documented Brand Monitor tables and columns
Inspect schemas and preview bounded samples
Estimate and run guarded read-only queries
defaultPrompt: List the Brand Monitor datasets and tables I can access.
Search the Brand Monitor data dictionary for a metric, then explain the relevant tables and columns.
Estimate and run a bounded read-only query against an approved Brand Monitor mart.
